title: 进口HMO婴配粉：中国妈妈半年，新增50万，为何能逆势增长？
speaker: Laetitia Garnier

segments.en: Yeah, it's interesting that China stood out given the macro conditions. What makes it, I guess, you're trying to business a bit more resilient to sort of the consumption weakness that we're seeing in the economy now?
segments.zh: 有趣的是，在宏观环境下中国业务表现突出。您认为是什么让您的业务对当前消费疲软更具韧性？

segments.en: I think the strategy that we implemented almost 10 years ago that was focusing on to health and wellness. We have almost focused all of our brands, our three macro brands, which is biostimes, where disaster was.
segments.zh: 我认为是我们近10年前实施的战略，专注于健康与 wellness。我们几乎将所有品牌，三大核心品牌，都聚焦于此。

segments.en: We believe that is the key underlining factor for us, right? We continue to invest in science and to all of men. If you look at in particular for our infant will formula business, the reason we have able to perform so fast is because of a speak to market and the innovation that we're bringing.
segments.zh: 我们相信这是关键因素。我们持续投入科学研发。特别是婴幼儿配方奶粉业务，之所以能快速表现，是因为我们贴近市场并持续创新。

segments.en: Our biggest disruption has been the launch of HMO. Human will always sacrifice infant formula business. We have the only imported brand in China to bring that product into the market, which is driving our end consumption state.
segments.zh: 我们最大的突破是推出了HMO产品。我们是唯一在中国市场推出该产品的进口品牌，这推动了我们的终端消费。

segments.en: As you know, that you know for infant formula, the first six months are very critical. In stage one, we had a growth rate of 68.8 percentage point. We added almost 500,000 new mothers in the first half, which is the benchmark.
segments.zh: 如您所知，婴幼儿配方奶粉的前六个月非常关键。在第一阶段，我们的增长率达到68.8个百分点。上半年新增近50万新妈妈，这是基准。

segments.en: So our continuous focus on education superior products are delivering that. And even in Swiss, we are now downgrading. We are criminalizing the portfolio.
segments.zh: 我们持续专注于消费者教育和优质产品，这正在带来成果。即使在Swisse，我们也在优化产品组合。

segments.en: We are going against the market defining trends of launching higher ASP niche category products to expand our address market. Our average ASP is 2000 RMP for the innovations.
segments.zh: 我们逆势推出更高ASP的细分品类产品，以扩大市场。创新产品的平均ASP为2000元。

segments.en: And they contribute to 10.6% of NSR in the last 12 months. So that will say is the superior execution our innovative approach and better marketing is driving the best in class results.
segments.zh: 过去12个月，它们贡献了净销售额的10.6%。可以说，卓越的执行力、创新的方法和更好的营销推动了行业领先的业绩。
